(i) a fossilized index is necessary to protect the records from logical modification, (ii) current indexing techniques do not satisfy the requirements of the fossilized index, and (iii) the GHT is an effective solution for the problem of fossilized index.

the GHT is a novel index structure that can be used to provide a fossilized index to preserve the trustworthiness of records in a WORM environment, and that the proposed method can be used to effectively dispose of index entries without compromising the trustworthiness.

the fundamental question of how to ensure that the records are trustworthy.
